Rule Set: Scaffold Safety (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: General rule
    Definition: Each platform on all working levels of scaffolds shall be fully planked or decked between the front uprights and the guardrail supports

    Title: General rule
    Definition: Guardrail systems shall be installed along all open sides and ends of platforms.
    Source: 1926.451(g)(4)
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: General rule
    Definition: The top edge height of toprails or equivalent member on supported scaffolds shall be installed between 38 inches (0.97 m) and 45 inches (1.2 m) above the platform surface.
    Source: 1926.451(g)(4)(ii)
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: General rule
